name: ended-stop-removes-the-attempt-from-status
description: After an ended stop, GET /status no longer lists the attempt (#525). This row observes the listing only: that the coordinator deletes the attempt's rows is pinned by the registry tests on each backend, not here. Same setup as ended-stop-answers-as-a-plain-stop: a peer session reads other.md, attempt a0826622451ec196f of session 66666666 takes EXCLUSIVE on notes.md, then its stop carries "ended": true. Only the peer's row is left. plain-subagent-stop-keeps-the-identity-in-status is the control: the same requests without the flag leave the attempt listed with a read (SHARED) of notes.md. The two backends' /status envelopes differ (see warn_mode 08 and 09), so every top-level key but sessions is dropped on both sides and sessions is compared in full; agent_id is scrubbed by name, so a row is told apart by the file it reads. Both backends.
_comment: The peer's session id is chosen so its agent id (053ac763-...) sorts before the attempt's (6fd28421-...) and it registers first: the Python coordinator lists named agents in the order they registered, the Node coordinator lists agents from its state table, and with this choice the control row's two entries come out in the same order on both. tracked_artifacts is dropped rather than compared because the Node artifact id is undashed hex, which the identity scrub does not match.
